description: Add a todo to the user's todoglow app. Only use this when the user explicitly asks to add a todo (e.g. 'todo 추가해줘', 'add this to my todos'). Do NOT call this automatically at conversation start — use update_thread instead. If called again in the same session with a pending todo, it will UPDATE the text instead of creating a new one.

text.description: The overarching topic or goal (max 200 chars). Keep it concise.
